Name: Extra Animal config (by zombifier)- android version
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Extra Animal Configs (EAC) - Android Version[/b] is an Android-compatible adaptation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs (EAC) by selph / zombifier[/url].

Extra Animal Config is a framework for custom farm-animal mods. It does not add animals by itself. Animal and content packs use it to define extra behavior beyond vanilla Stardew Valley, including alternate feed, multiple produce types, additional harvest methods, custom appearance rules, special housing behavior, attacks/healing, and other extended animal data.

This Android build is based on upstream version [b]1.9.14[/b] and keeps the original UniqueID [b]selph.ExtraAnimalConfig[/b] so mods which depend on Extra Animal Config can recognize it normally.

[b]Published with permission from the original author.[/b]

[b]Features[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Android-compatible build of Extra Animal Config 1.9.14.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Preserves the original framework used by custom animal/content packs.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Supports the original Extra Animal Config asset and dependency ID: selph.ExtraAnimalConfig.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Preserves upstream support for custom animal produce and harvest behavior.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Preserves extra produce slots and multiple simultaneous produce.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Preserves conditioned animal appearance / texture overrides.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Preserves alternate housing, rain/winter behavior, speed, attacks/healing, harvesting behavior, GSQs, and other upstream EAC features.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Preserves the original English, French, Portuguese, and Chinese i18n files.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Includes the Apache 2.0 license and a clear Android modification notice.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]

[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6.15.x on Android[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI 4.0.9+[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Optional[/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Content Patcher or other frameworks required by the animal/content packs you use with Extra Animal Config.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]

[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 build 26177 on Android[/font][/*]

[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Installation[/b][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Fully close Stardew Valley and SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Delete any existing [b]ExtraAnimalConfig[/b] folder from your Mods folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Do [b]not[/b] keep the original desktop Extra Animal Config installed beside this Android version.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Extract the [b]ExtraAnimalConfig[/b] folder from this download into your SMAPI Mods folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Install the animal/content packs that require Extra Animal Config normally.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Compatibility / Important notes[/b]

This is a [b]replacement Android build[/b], not an add-on. Do not install it together with the original Extra Animal Config.

The UniqueID intentionally remains [b]selph.ExtraAnimalConfig[/b]. This is necessary so existing content packs which list Extra Animal Config as a dependency can recognize the Android version.

[b]Known Android limitation:[/b] the desktop version uses two AnimalHouse Harmony transpilers for trough/feed handling. Those desktop-specific transpilers do not match the tested Android game assembly and are bypassed in this build. Because of that, mods which rely specifically on custom non-hay feed/trough placement or building-wide feed overrides may not behave exactly like they do on desktop.

The rest of the framework is left as close to upstream 1.9.14 as possible. [b]Not every Extra Animal Config feature has been individually verified on Android[/b], so pack-specific testing is still important. If a specific animal/content pack behaves differently on Android, please include a fresh [b]SMAPI-latest.txt[/b] after reproducing the problem.

This framework does nothing on its own; you need an animal/content pack which uses Extra Animal Config.
